closest_baselines.captures: Exact per-context executed lines and arcs through a mature public measurement API.
closest_baselines.not_claimed: No replacement for Coverage.py, path coverage, or context APIs.
closest_baselines.planned_direct_comparison: Compare profile-level union/intersection against a canonical multiset of per-selector line-and-arc path shapes.

closest_baselines.captures: Whether each Boolean condition is shown to independently affect the decision in the frozen truth table.
closest_baselines.not_claimed: No general MC/DC engine or certification claim.
closest_baselines.planned_direct_comparison: Compare exact MFA/role independence witnesses with dropped-conjunct mutant outcomes.

closest_baselines.captures: Which t-way input or configuration combinations are represented.
closest_baselines.not_claimed: No covering-array generation, residual-risk estimate, or population-level fault-detection capacity.
closest_baselines.planned_direct_comparison: Retain all four exact Boolean quadrants and five fixed subsets without converting them into a scalar coverage percentage.

closest_baselines.captures: Covered computation that dynamically influences an oracle.
closest_baselines.not_claimed: No dynamic slicing or oracle-influence computation.
closest_baselines.planned_direct_comparison: Use checked coverage as a boundary: path partitions retain per-selector control-flow co-occurrence but not data/control dependence to assertions.

closest_baselines.captures: Exact killed/survived/indeterminate outcomes for predeclared fault controls under exact selector profiles.
closest_baselines.not_claimed: No mutation adequacy, representative operator quality, equivalent-mutant solution, or method superiority.
closest_baselines.planned_direct_comparison: Compare independently reconstructed truth-table independence relations with the complete asymmetric mutant/profile table.

falsification_and_redesign: Profile statement or arc union/intersection differs after bytes are frozen.
Anonymous path multisets are unstable across clean Python 3.11-3.14 runs.
Profiles differ only through selector names or cardinality artifacts.
A simpler truth-table or MC/DC representation captures the same complete relation.
Coverage.py contexts add no evidence beyond already frozen input labels.
Mutation outcomes require post-outcome operator or selector tuning.
The asymmetric mutant table diverges from preregistration.
Equivalent, invalid, or indeterminate mutants dominate the design.
Representation changes alter path identities without semantic change.
The verifier cannot reject coordinated semantic substitution beyond digest recomputation.
Publication or execution cost exceeds the bounded evidence value.

novelty_boundary.reason: Contexts, path coverage, MC/DC, combinatorial coverage, checked coverage, mutation testing, and oracle analysis are established. The preregistered experiment can test only the incremental evidence value of one integrity-bound combination in one owned-synthetic case.

planned_difference.cross_evidence_relation: Whether fixed truth-table condition-independence witnesses agree with the predeclared incidence of dropped-conjunct mutants.
planned_difference.information_loss_tested: Whether profile-level statement and arc union/intersection erase which path shapes co-occur within individual logical tests.
planned_difference.integrity_boundary: Expected, observed, unexpected, and indeterminate evidence must remain separate and be independently reconstructed beyond unkeyed digest equality.
planned_difference.representation: An integrity-bound, order-independent multiset of exact per-selector executed-statement and executed-arc path shapes, with selector, quadrant, context, and invocation bindings retained separately.

search_protocol.exclusion_rule: Exclude marketing summaries, unsourced claims, tooling comparisons without a stable primary source, and any source selected only after observing the planned experiment's outcomes.
search_protocol.inclusion_rule: Include primary or authoritative sources that directly define a baseline, measurement capability, known limitation, or validity threat relevant to selector-context partitions, condition interactions, oracle evidence, or mutation outcomes.
